text:
marta: Alert: shelf-42 hit 85% GPU slab utilization + egress tail latency spike. Scheduler kicked a preemptive backfill and I’m seeing a weird race where warm-pool spawns compete with reclaim, causing slab churn. anyone seen this exact pattern?
kevin: Yep, saw that last week in rack18 — NVLink bursts + NIC qdepth spike. warm-pool allocs grab HBM then preempt fires; we end up doing double work.
raj: Can you paste the log snippet? suspect race between preempt window (2s) and warm-pool allocation timeout (1s).
marta: Here’s the snippet: 
```
[2026-03-22T10:12:05Z] scheduler: preempt:init tenant=acme-foo reason=slab_pressure shelf=42
[2026-03-22T10:12:06Z] warmpool: spawn request -> node=rack18-slot3
[2026-03-22T10:12:06Z] node: allocate hbm -> success
[2026-03-22T10:12:06Z] scheduler: preempt:evict tenant=acme-foo -> evict start
[2026-03-22T10:12:07Z] nic: qlen spike -> 12000
```
kevin: That ~1s overlap is enough to cause double allocations + evict churn. Short-lived allocations trash the slab allocator. Quick mitigation would be debounce preempt or make warm-pool backoff randomized and prefer soft-reserve.
olivia: Quick mitigation proposal: bump shelf.preempt_threshold to 90% and add a 30s debounce between 'preempt' decision and actual eviction when a warm-pool spawn is in-flight. Low-risk, reversible.
raj: Long term: change warm-pool flow to issue a soft-reserve (logical reservation) first, then attempt hard-alloc after N seconds if still needed. That avoids grabbing HBM mid-preempt.
marta: What’s the cost impact if we leave this as-is during peak?
kevin: Rough numbers from last week: churn on that shelf was adding ~12% extra GPU-hours during the peak window. Disabling early hard-alloc warm-pool drops that to ~3%, but increases cold-start latency — p95 +80ms for affected allocations.
marta: Action items: olivia -> patch rack-policy to +30s debounce (canary us-west-1), raj -> prototype soft-reserve flow, kevin -> add slab_churn alert and watch metrics, I’ll write a short runbook update.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started for rack-policy/debounce v1 -> us-west-1 (10% nodes)
marta: thanks — watching dashboards. https://redwood.ops/dashboards/shelf-42-churn
kevin: handy query to track during rollout:
```
curl 'https://prom/api/v1/query?query=slab_churn_rate{shelf="42"}'
```
marta: tagging @oncall for extra eyes during canary :eyes:
